pixel_origin: Original Nestopia video callback; captured controlled fixture, not natural campaign traversal.
limitations: Transparent background-difference candidate layers retain flat background pixels where native BG unit tiles replace brick texture; they are not certified clean unit sprites.
No combat damage, castle defense bonus, or free-placement mechanics inferred from artwork.

tables.scope: Small immutable original data tables, no executable ROM bytes.

sprite_scope.additional_frame_policy: The second requested frame reuses the same verified native pose; motion comes from actual game positions. No uncaptured attack/defend pose is claimed.
sprite_scope.transparency: Original CHR background pattern index, not RGB keying or a difference against brick texture.
